review.rationale: Dirtiness can imply untidiness, moral badness, or literal soil; clarify whether cleanliness alone counters this enemy.
Hostility is closely associated with anger, but enduring hatred and a moment of anger are distinct.
Being less hopeful ranges from discouragement to hopeless despair; decide how strong reinforcement must be.
Danger can cause fear, but danger is not the emotion; record any decision to count causes as reinforcement.
Grief can be a particular sadness or a distinct response to bereavement; document the breadth of the enemy concept.
Punishment may be humane or cruel; a generic punitive act must not automatically imply deliberate cruelty.
